packageRules.description: Majors need approval in the Dependency Dashboard. Read the changelog first.
Keep ExcaliDash in lockstep. The images carry no (backend) or the wrong (frontend: nginx base image) source label, so point Renovate at the real repo for release notes.
Strip the -alpine suffix before comparing versions, so tags like 9.1.3-alpine match upstream releases like 9.1.3.

PostgreSQL publishes no GitHub releases (the image source is docker-library/postgres), so link the official release notes instead. Digest-only updates have no newVersion, so fall back to the current version.
